text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a stunning 1st place finish by 
Duramente! It's Duramente! The 8th in 
history! A new Classic Triple Crown 
Umamusume is born!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Undeterred by the grueling 3,000 meters! 
Right now! She has seized glorious 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, is Duramente struggling a bit? 
And who could blame her!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Even so! Catch your breath... stand tall, 
and puff out your chest—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
High into the air, she thrust her fist! It 
is a moment of pure triumph...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Just listen to this thunderous roar! Fifty 
thousand spectators are trembling with 
excitement at the birth of a new 
legend...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The strongest Umamusume... The strongest 
is me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The birth of a new Classic Triple Crown 
Umamusume... Seeing her majestic presence, 
the cheers from the crowd did not cease 
for quite some time—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: This makes it the second time.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Even from the stands, those words reached 
me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Of course I can hear it. You were the one 
who said it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm truly so glad that I was able to 
become a Triple Crown Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
With this, I have carved one more... 
hoofprint into our family's great history.
choice_data_list: There's one more thing left to engrave—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. —Conquering the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "Even if I look back on today's race—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I don't wanna lose, I'm gonna... win 
thissssss!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Guuuuuugh...!! It's so frustrating...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dammit...! Uggghhhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, Kitasan Black...! Great job out 
there, that was an amazing run!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That's it! That reckless, straightforward 
run... it was so moving! I know you'll win 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Kitasaaan Blaaack--!! We're rooting for 
you! Do your best~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chaaaan!! You were so cooool!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ! Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...It's fine. This is my running style...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I won't lose next time. 
—AB-SO-LUTELY not!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No...
choice_data_list:
...She was different from how she's been 
up until now.

...She was different from how she's been 
up until now.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...She was like a completely 
different person.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"She was strong. ...Strong enough to send 
shivers down my spine."
choice_data_list: We'll be rivals next year too!
We'll be rivals next year too!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Rivals...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you sure you want to jump straight 
to next year? What about our next target 
race?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If you have any ideas, I'd love to hear 
them.
choice_data_list: I was thinking about the "Nakayama Kinen".

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see. With your sights set on overseas 
racing, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many Umamusume who run in the Nakayama 
Kinen are aiming for overseas races. The 
experience gained there should lead 
straight to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Let's make our next goal the 
Nakayama Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With all our business finished, I walked 
Duramente back to the dorms... where Fuji 
Kiseki was cleaning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not from the Miho Dormitory where 
Duramente lives... but the dorm leader of 
the other one, the Ritto Dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Duramente. How was the race?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I have successfully won.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I see, congratulations! I'm so glad.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Our dorms may be different, but 
we're still students of the same academy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I feel a kind of kinship with 
you, for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Something... close?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"My mother is a stage actress, you see. 
She gives people dreams through the 
stage."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—An overwhelming, unreal performance! A 
thrilling, dreamlike stage!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Captivating people's hearts with an 
unforgettable brilliance... Doesn't that 
sound like a certain someone?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Your Trainer is quite 
straightforward, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Duramente's aiming for the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe, right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If she can pull off a victory... it would 
rewrite common sense itself."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That sounds super exciting!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Both as Fuji-senpai the dorm head... and 
as myself, I'm rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the future you'll 
carve out. Please, show many more girls 
what it means to dream.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――Ah, welcome back, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well then, good luck! See you later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pat pat)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki gave Duramente a gentle pat on 
the head and went to greet another 
Umamusume who seemed to have just returned 
from self-training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...It's warm.
choice_data_list: A lot of people are cheering for us, huh

A lot of people are cheering for us, 
aren't they

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I've only ever thought about 
living up to my clan's expectations, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —I'm looking forward to next year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's redouble our training efforts toward 
our next target race, the Nakayama Kinen.
